item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
SupaSidebar 1.0.1

What’s New

  • Updated Onboarding: The onboarding experience has been redesigned.

Improvements

  • Auto-Show Is Now Opt-In for New Setups: The sidebar no longer appears automatically when you focus a browser unless you enable Auto Show on Browser Focus.
  • Smart Attach Stays in Sync: The menu and Preferences now agree with the sidebar’s actual attachment mode.
  • Sidebar Size and Position Are Remembered: A sidebar you move or resize returns to the same position and height after relaunching SupaSidebar.

Bug Fixes

  • Dragging a link or folder into a folder no longer moves the entire sidebar window.

item.title: Version 1.1.0-beta.1
item.description:
SupaSidebar 1.1.0-beta.1

What’s New

  • Tab Auto-Close: Idle tabs close on their own after a timeout you set, and land in a new Archived Tabs list.
  • Portable Export: Export your links as browser bookmarks, plain JSON, or a full backup that restores your setup on a new Mac.
  • Window Groups in Live Tabs: When a browser has two or more windows open, its tabs group under headers you can rename and collapse.
  • Window Lock: Lock a whole window so none of its tabs get closed, and new tabs opened there stay protected too.
  • Number Keys for Browsers: Press 1-9 in the command panel or the Open With popover to open a link in that browser or profile.
  • Rename With ⌘-Click: A new ⌘+Click behavior starts renaming a link instead of opening it.
  • Version in the Menu Bar: The menu bar now shows your version above Check for Updates.

Improvements

  • Open With Follows Your Habits: Browsers and profiles are ordered by how often you actually open links with them.

Notes

  • Tab Auto-Close is off by default. Turn it on in Preferences > Archived Tabs, then set the timeout and how many tabs to keep.
  • Archived tabs are recoverable from Archived Tabs in the sidebar menu, so nothing closed is lost.
